stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Jason Young tops the card with 36 pts, double chance locked away and the recliner warming up.

stories.title: Logjam
stories.detail: 2 tied at the top on 36 - countback territory

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 17 coming home vs 10 out

stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 14 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: Group Honours
stories.detail: Peter Street had the better of Sam Raves all day, 34 to 31 in the end.

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Richard Allsopp of Royal Sydney GC is welcome back anytime, preferably off a few less shots.

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: The Phoenix
stories.detail: Wipe then 3-pointer on holes 16 & 17 - drama then redemption

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 7 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 17, back nine 10 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 14 & 15 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Bounce-Back Merchant
stories.detail: Answered every wipe with points next hole - never let one become two

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Perfectly Mediocre
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers straight - one point at a time, every time

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Steady Eddie
stories.detail: 8 two-pointers, not a wipe in sight - metronomic golf

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 2-5 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 6 & 7 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Kick, Chase, Repeat
stories.detail: 6 1-pointers in a row at some point - always knocking, never scoring

stories.title: Stay Strong
stories.detail: 5 1-pointers straight on holes 18-4 - the commentators have gone quiet

stories.title: The Course Wins Again
stories.detail: 3 straight on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the handicap card stays in the bag

comingLast.roast: a high marker holding the blue balls - the honour board salutes the effort
3 holes to dodge the double blue - the field is glued to his group
on 20 with 4 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
4 left, 1 needed, one bar holding its breath
on 20 at 1.4 - his playing partners are witnesses now, not opponents
sitting 1 above the drop zone - Bradley would love the company
sitting 2 above Bradley and driving very, very carefully
2 above Bradley - the kind of lead that keeps a man honest
his lead over Bradley is 5 - a strong gust could move it
